svg.aria-label: Doomsday System: A management platform for a post-apocalyptic world: camps, survivors, supplies and the transfers between outposts. The interesting part is the rules engine, which refuses impossible moves like shipping water a camp doesn't have. NestJS API, React dashboard and end to end tests on both sides.
